name: noteato
description: A minimal, bloat-free, block-based note taking app for Mac — markdown, dictation, side-by-side panes. No accounts, no cloud, no lock-in.
author: Shashank Bhat

scripts.build:mac: npm run clean && npm run build:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run clean && npm run build:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.build:mac:intel: npm run clean && npm run build:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run build:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish always
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.bench: npm run bench:search && npm run bench:memory
